title: Operation Whiskerfall: The Berlin Reckoning
description: Defeat all eight regional commanders, enter the unlocked Berlin Sector, and end Adolph Whisker’s rule. Killing him wins the campaign.

title: Paws Off the Airwaves
description: Moth has mapped three orchard alarm relays. Disable each relay without needing to wipe out the whole garrison, then bring her the fuses.

steps.label: Remove the three alarm fuses
Return the fuses to Moth

followUp: After this assignment, speak with Marmalade about “The Baker’s Last Basket”.

title: The Baker’s Last Basket
description: Marmalade hid a basket of bread beside the old road. Recover it and carry it home. You move more slowly while carrying the basket.

steps.label: Recover the basket beside the old road
Bring the bread to Marmalade in Willow Camp

followUp: After this assignment, speak with Wayfinder Poppy about “A Courier’s First Run”.

title: Not One Paw Left Behind
description: Nurse Fern’s missing scouts are alive. Use a field medkit on each wounded cat, then report back. Each patient needs one medkit.

steps.label: Treat Alder and Sorrel with field medkits
Tell Nurse Fern both scouts are stable

followUp: After this assignment, speak with Professor Purr about “What the Owls Heard”.

title: What the Owls Heard
description: Professor Purr needs recordings from three listening stones. Interact at each point, then remain close and clear of enemies for four seconds.

steps.label: Record all three listening stones
Deliver the recordings to Professor Purr

followUp: After this assignment, speak with Wayfinder Bramble about “Letters through Mosswood”.

title: An Avalanche of Our Own
description: Miner Flint has placed charges beside the battery road. Arm both charges, withdraw to the detonator and bring the mountainside down on the supply line.

steps.label: Arm both rock charges
Trigger the charges from the remote detonator
Tell Miner Flint the supply road is cut

followUp: After this assignment, speak with Cartographer Pebble about “A Map Written in Echoes”.

title: A Map Written in Echoes
description: Cartographer Pebble scattered three survey pages while escaping the quarry. Search the different overlooks and return the whole map.

steps.label: Gather the three scattered survey pages
Return the complete survey to Pebble

followUp: After this assignment, speak with Wayfinder Granite about “Medicine for the Pass”.

title: The Aurora Code
description: Radio Cat Solstice can break Whiteclaw’s cipher if you tune the northern dishes in order. Defend the last receiver while its signal uploads.

steps.label: Tune the first dish to the moon frequency
Tune the second dish to the aurora frequency
Stay at the uplink while the cipher uploads
Give the decoded signal to Solstice

followUp: After this assignment, speak with Grandma Mittens about “A Hearth for Snowhaven”.

title: A Hearth for Snowhaven
description: Grandma Mittens needs heater cells before nightfall. Recover both cells, carry them through the snow and bring them to her hearth.

steps.label: Recover both heater cells
Bring the heater cells to Grandma Mittens

followUp: After this assignment, speak with Wayfinder Flurry about “Warmth for Snowhaven”.

title: Water Beneath the Sand
description: Pumpkeeper Fennel knows where the old well survives. Open its intake, keep the purifier running, and carry a clean water sample back to the oasis.

steps.label: Open the buried well intake
Keep the purifier running for twelve seconds
Bring clean water to Pumpkeeper Fennel

followUp: After this assignment, speak with Archivist Sable about “The Mirage Ledger”.

title: The Mirage Ledger
description: Archivist Sable has one chance to expose a supply fraud. Read the depot schedule, take the real ledger from its hiding place and return before it disappears.

steps.label: Decode the depot schedule
Recover the real caravan ledger
Bring the ledger to Archivist Sable

followUp: After this assignment, speak with Wayfinder Saffron about “Water for the Caravan”.

title: Lanterns in the Fog
description: Doctor Willow’s fishing crew was caught in a gas attack. Find all three lanterns and use one field medkit to treat each stranded fisher.

steps.label: Treat the three fishers with field medkits
Report the rescue to Doctor Willow

followUp: After this assignment, speak with Lockkeeper Ripple about “The River Remembers”.

title: The River Remembers
description: Lockkeeper Ripple wants the delta flowing again. Release both pressure valves before opening the main floodgate. No amount of defeated guards can turn these wheels for you.

steps.label: Release both pressure valves
Open the main river floodgate
Tell Lockkeeper Ripple the river is free

followUp: After this assignment, speak with Wayfinder Ripple about “The Delta Messenger”.

title: The Quiet Assembly Line
description: Welder Copper has found the furnace’s weak points. Plant three shaped charges and set them off from a safe console to stop the war production.

steps.label: Arm the three shaped charges
Use the safety console to destroy the line
Tell Welder Copper the assembly line has stopped

followUp: After this assignment, speak with Tinker Button about “Cinder’s Spare Heart”.

title: Cinder’s Spare Heart
description: Tinker Button can build a refugee warning beacon from a crashed drone. Retrieve its core, then spend eight materials to repair the beacon outside Ashford.

steps.label: Retrieve the crashed drone’s power core
Repair the warning beacon using eight materials
Show Tinker Button the beacon is working

followUp: After this assignment, speak with Wayfinder Coal about “A Package for the Forge”.

title: Nine Lives of Intelligence
description: Agent Velvet needs proof of what waits in Berlin. Record the outer patrol frequencies, steal the gate manifest and return to Dawnbridge.

steps.label: Record the outer patrol frequencies
Steal the Berlin gate manifest
Give Agent Velvet the Berlin intelligence

followUp: After this assignment, speak with Poet Patches about “One Voice Before Dawn”.

title: One Voice Before Dawn
description: Poet Patches wants the captive city to hear hope. Start the old transmitter, protect its broadcast and return when the resistance anthem reaches Berlin.

steps.label: Tune the old city transmitter
Protect the resistance broadcast for twenty seconds
Tell Poet Patches the city heard the anthem

followUp: After this assignment, speak with Wayfinder Starling about “The Last Dispatch”.

title: Hold the Orchard Line
description: Captain Saffron’s road camp is sheltering the harvest crews. Ring its defense bell and protect the supply chest from three arriving squads. Every wave must be defeated; there is no overall kill timer. Intermissions are preparation time.

title: Turn the Lantern Line
description: Ranger Crag has spotted the commander coordinating the offensive. Hold Lantern Ridge for 18 seconds while the mountaineers withdraw, then pursue the battery captain and disable the command post. No kill deadline. A checkpoint preserves the withdrawal.

title: Last Water at Sundial
description: Sol’s caravan cannot leave without its water stores. Defend the desert road camp against four raiding waves. Every wave must be defeated; there is no overall kill timer. Intermissions are preparation time.

title: A Hearth in the Ash
description: Engineer Cinder’s evacuation camp is the last refuge before the foundries. Hold its supply chest against four escalating siege waves. Every wave must be defeated; there is no overall kill timer. Intermissions are preparation time.

title: Bramble’s Silent Sawmill
description: Juniper has found the three drives that feed the occupiers’ sawmill. Plant a charge on each drive, then retreat to the separate remote switch.

steps.label: Plant all three demolition charges
Use the separate remote switch

title: Break the Winter Battery
description: Lumi wants the frozen artillery relay silenced. Arm its three relay charges and use the sheltered remote switch to destroy them together.

steps.label: Plant all three demolition charges
Use the separate remote switch

title: Cut the Floodgate Supply
description: Reed has marked three pumping engines feeding the military docks. Place the charges before using the separate remote switch.

steps.label: Plant all three demolition charges

steps.label: Plant all three demolition charges

title: A Light Beyond the Snow

steps.label: Relight the three roadside beacons

title: Salvage the Glass Tide
description: Recover the sealed rescue stores from the Glass-Tide wreck. Tinker Pip at Lantern Quay can use the surviving signal lenses.
followUp: After this assignment, speak with Tinker Pip about “Cut the Harpoon Lines”.

title: Cut the Harpoon Lines
description: Clear every guard from Harpoon Moorings so the fishing boats can move again. Scout Mira is waiting at Lantern Quay with news from the southern islands.
followUp: After this assignment, speak with Scout Mira about “The Drowned Bell Prisoners”.

title: The Drowned Bell Prisoners
description: Cross the Crown Causeway and clear Drowned Bell Stockade to free its captive ferrymen. Find Captain Coral at Crownrest Haven afterward.
followUp: After this assignment, speak with Captain Coral about “Break the Crown Blockade”.

title: Break the Crown Blockade
description: Overrun Crown Fleet Anchorage and seize the blockade’s supply convoy. Herbalist Fenn at Crownrest will help the evacuated families return home.
followUp: After this assignment, speak with Herbalist Fenn about “The Homecoming Lights”.

title: The Homecoming Lights
description: Relight two forgotten island lanterns, then bring the ferry chart back to Crownrest. The defended watch camps will need your help keeping these routes open.

steps.label: Relight both island lanterns
Return the safe-passage chart to Crownrest

title: Keep the Saltwind Burning
description: Keeper Nacre needs the Saltwind beacon protected while the northern ferries find the coast. Ring the watch bell and hold its supply chest through three assaults. After this defense, speak with Bosun Brindle about “A Shore for the Shipwrecked”.

wavePlan.name: The Fog Patrol
wavePlan.brief: Scouts probe the beacon. Watch the harpoon lane.

wavePlan.name: Blades in the Mist
wavePlan.brief: Tideblades close in while a medic keeps their squad moving.

wavePlan.name: The Bell at Saltwind
wavePlan.brief: A Bellringer and Shellguard lead the final assault.

followUp: After this defense, speak with Bosun Brindle about “A Shore for the Shipwrecked”.

title: A Shore for the Shipwrecked
description: Bosun Brindle has brought the wreck survivors ashore. Defend their rescue stores until the last wounded sailor reaches safety. After this defense, speak with Scout Mira about “The Last Lantern Holds”.

wavePlan.name: Rope-Cutters
wavePlan.brief: Fast raiders are racing toward the rescue stores.

wavePlan.name: Harpoons on the Rise
wavePlan.brief: Circle the shell shield and sidestep the harpoon lanes.

wavePlan.name: The Rescue Breakers
wavePlan.brief: A medic and Bellringer support a flanking squad.

wavePlan.name: Brindle’s Last Boat
wavePlan.brief: The heavy escort has arrived. Keep the stores intact.

followUp: After this defense, speak with Scout Mira about “The Last Lantern Holds”.

title: The Last Lantern Holds
description: Scout Mira is keeping the causeway open for the southbound refugees. Defend the last lantern against five waves to earn a choice of rare protective equipment. After this defense, speak with Captain Coral about “Stand at Reedcrown Landing”.

wavePlan.name: Causeway Runners
wavePlan.brief: Runners strike first. Keep them away from the lantern stores.

wavePlan.name: Hook and Shield
wavePlan.brief: Harpoons and shields advance together.

wavePlan.name: Three Notes of Thunder
wavePlan.brief: The storm circles strike in sequence. Interrupt the Bellringer.

wavePlan.name: The Split Advance
wavePlan.brief: Two attack styles close on opposite sides of the causeway.

wavePlan.name: The Last Lantern Siege
wavePlan.brief: The final siege brings shell armor, harpoons and a rocket team.

followUp: After this defense, speak with Captain Coral about “Stand at Reedcrown Landing”.

title: Stand at Reedcrown Landing
description: Captain Coral needs a safe landing for the displaced island families. Hold the landing stores through four Crown Fleet assaults. After this defense, speak with Herbalist Fenn about “Let the Sunken Bell Ring”.

wavePlan.name: Landing Party
wavePlan.brief: The fleet mixes ambushers with coastal assault troops.

wavePlan.name: Reedbank Cutters
wavePlan.brief: Three Tideblades lead a fast raid.

wavePlan.name: The Crown Chimes
wavePlan.brief: Two Bellringers make standing still dangerous.

wavePlan.name: The Landing Breakers
wavePlan.brief: Break the shields before the heavy team reaches the stores.

followUp: After this defense, speak with Herbalist Fenn about “Let the Sunken Bell Ring”.

title: Let the Sunken Bell Ring
description: Herbalist Fenn is turning the old bell platform into a medicine station. Guard its supplies through five waves so the island crews can hear a friendly signal again. After this defense, speak with Tinker Pip about “Until the Last Ferry Leaves”.

wavePlan.name: Medicine Raiders
wavePlan.brief: Ambushers are testing the medicine station.

wavePlan.name: The Hooked Crescent
wavePlan.brief: The flanking harpoons cover a blade rush.

wavePlan.name: Drowned Patrol
wavePlan.brief: A storm bell supports the gun crews.

wavePlan.name: The Broken Choir
wavePlan.brief: Silence the Bellringers or the patrols keep their rally bonus.

wavePlan.name: The Bell Platform Siege
wavePlan.brief: Shellguards hold the lane while the siege team advances.

followUp: After this defense, speak with Tinker Pip about “Until the Last Ferry Leaves”.

title: Until the Last Ferry Leaves
description: Tinker Pip has repaired the evacuation ferries, but the Crown Fleet is closing on the pier. Protect the final supplies through six waves and claim one rare keepsake for the party. After this defense, speak with Keeper Nacre about “A Light Beyond the Snow”.

wavePlan.name: The Pier Patrol
wavePlan.brief: Clear the first landing party.

wavePlan.name: Hooks in the Spray
wavePlan.brief: Keep moving across the harpoon lanes.

wavePlan.name: The Shell Wall
wavePlan.brief: Draw the shells into their exposed recovery.

wavePlan.name: The Storm Choir
wavePlan.brief: Interrupt the bells before their circles fill the pier.

wavePlan.name: Ferry-Cutters
wavePlan.brief: Fast blades race the final ferry loading.

wavePlan.name: The Crown Fleet’s Last Assault
wavePlan.brief: Hold against the full fleet escort. This is the final wave.

followUp: After this defense, speak with Keeper Nacre about “A Light Beyond the Snow”.

title: When the Orchard Answers
opening: Saffron: Those orders were signed by every commander. This is a coordinated offensive. Get the harvest crews out; we will hold the road together.
fallback: Juniper: The supply road is compromised. Walk the families to the fallback lantern. I am staying with the last cart.
victory: Saffron: They planned to silence one village at a time. Now every village will hear us. The signal crews are yours.
description: Saffron: Those orders were signed by every commander. This is a coordinated offensive. Get the harvest crews out; we will hold the road together. Three stages: hold the barricade, escort the evacuation, then disable the siege command. No overall kill timer. Stage checkpoints preserve completed work. Choose a rescued medic team or reinforced barricade before the first attack.

title: The Night Warmhearth Fell
opening: Lumi: Whiteclaw left the ferry route on the enemy frequency. Our safe road is gone. Save the families first; we can rebuild a road.
fallback: Crag: My mountaineers found a shelter beyond the bend. Cover Lumi while she brings the wounded through.
victory: Lumi: Every name on my list is accounted for. Take our siege-breaker and the medical team. Nobody faces Berlin alone.
description: Lumi: Whiteclaw left the ferry route on the enemy frequency. Our safe road is gone. Save the families first; we can rebuild a road. Three stages: hold the barricade, escort the evacuation, then disable the siege command. No overall kill timer. Stage checkpoints preserve completed work. Choose a rescued medic team or reinforced barricade before the first attack.

title: All Roads to the Resistance
opening: Dawn: The commanders are falling, but Whisker is sending his reserve army. Keep this approach open and all our friends can join the final push.
fallback: Cinder: The evacuation wagons carry the charges for Berlin. Walk them past the searchlights. I will keep the wheels turning.
victory: Dawn: Signals, medicine, and a road through the dark. Every small victory brought us here. Our allies will meet you at Berlin.
description: Dawn: The commanders are falling, but Whisker is sending his reserve army. Keep this approach open and all our friends can join the final push. Three stages: hold the barricade, escort the evacuation, then disable the siege command. No overall kill timer. Stage checkpoints preserve completed work. Choose a rescued medic team or reinforced barricade before the first attack.

title: The Gunsmith Below
description: Wick refuses to let the occupiers turn his precision prototype on the forest. Recover two stolen parts around Owl’s Grotto, then defeat the prototype’s guard and bring back the receiver. Unique reward: Lanternline Rifle.

steps.label: Recover both prototype parts
Defeat the receiver guards, then recover the prototype

title: The Last Watch
description: A lone defender still keeps the ruined watchtower’s lantern. Repair its signal, hold the broadcast briefly, and defeat the assault leader. Unique reward: Last Watch Armor.

steps.label: Repair the watchtower signal
Broadcast for 15 seconds
Defeat the assault leader and retrieve the orders

title: The Blackglass Trail
description: Vesper’s violet ribbons reveal a supply route beyond Ember Rest. Read the trail signs, intercept an elite patrol, and return its route book. Unique reward: Blackglass Pathfinder Armor.

steps.label: Read both Blackglass trail signs
Defeat the elite patrol and recover its route book

title: A Breath Beneath the Ice
rewardStatement: REWARD: Winter’s Whisper — freeze foes with precise shots — plus Frost Breath, a sweeping cone of biting cold.
description: Wake both lake pumps, then turn the central regulator. The stone crossing between the two lakes is always safe. Entrance requires the Rimeglass Valve Key. Search the Frozen Courier Cache east of Badger’s Lantern in Stonecrest. Defeat its three sentries, then recover the valve key. Defeat the guardian, recover its expedition seal, then return to Keeper Thistle. REWARD: Winter’s Whisper — freeze foes with precise shots — plus Frost Breath, a sweeping cone of biting cold.
offer: Wake both lake pumps, then turn the central regulator. The stone crossing between the two lakes is always safe. Entrance requires the Rimeglass Valve Key. Search the Frozen Courier Cache east of Badger’s Lantern in Stonecrest. Defeat its three sentries, then recover the valve key. Defeat the guardian, recover its expedition seal, then return to Keeper Thistle. REWARD: Winter’s Whisper — freeze foes with precise shots — plus Frost Breath, a sweeping cone of biting cold.
completion: The expedition seal is safe. REWARD: Winter’s Whisper — freeze foes with precise shots — plus Frost Breath, a sweeping cone of biting cold.
discoveryClue: Follow the frost-blue pipes northeast from Warmhearth to Keeper Thistle.

title: The Furnace That Wouldn’t Die
rewardStatement: REWARD: Ember Bastion Armor — taking a hit awakens a brief protective bulwark.
description: Turn one valve in each side wing to cool the furnace bridge. Either wing can be visited first; the bridge stays open. Entrance requires the Cindercoil Foundry Key. Search the Smuggler’s Tool Chest east of Reedlight Refuge in Reedwater. Defeat its three guards, then recover the foundry key. Defeat the guardian, recover its expedition seal, then return to Foreman Brindle. REWARD: Ember Bastion Armor — taking a hit awakens a brief protective bulwark.
offer: Turn one valve in each side wing to cool the furnace bridge. Either wing can be visited first; the bridge stays open. Entrance requires the Cindercoil Foundry Key. Defeat the guardian, recover its expedition seal, then return to Foreman Brindle. REWARD: Ember Bastion Armor — taking a hit awakens a brief protective bulwark.
completion: The expedition seal is safe. REWARD: Ember Bastion Armor — taking a hit awakens a brief protective bulwark.
discoveryClue: Follow the silent furnace chimneys east of Ember Rest to Foreman Brindle.

title: The Wind Remembers
rewardStatement: REWARD: Galeweave Mantle — reload for speed and an empowered shot — plus Aurora Well, a healing sanctuary.
description: Ring the three terrace bells in any order, then awaken the sanctuary in the middle of the loop. Defeat the guardian, recover its expedition seal, then return to Pilgrim Sora. REWARD: Galeweave Mantle — reload for speed and an empowered shot — plus Aurora Well, a healing sanctuary.
offer: Ring the three terrace bells in any order, then awaken the sanctuary in the middle of the loop. Defeat the guardian, recover its expedition seal, then return to Pilgrim Sora. REWARD: Galeweave Mantle — reload for speed and an empowered shot — plus Aurora Well, a healing sanctuary.
completion: The expedition seal is safe. REWARD: Galeweave Mantle — reload for speed and an empowered shot — plus Aurora Well, a healing sanctuary.
discoveryClue: Follow the wind bells northeast of Reedlight Refuge to Pilgrim Sora.

title: The Beast Beneath the Crown
rewardStatement: REWARD: Legendary Sea Beast Armor — summon spectral tentacles with repeated firearm hits and leave slowing ink when you dodge.
description: Release the three tide anchors along the flooded piers. Beyond the gate waits Nacremaw, the Great Kraken: an optional level 26 challenge with no time limit. Defeat Nacremaw, the Great Kraken, recover its expedition seal, then return to Diver Pearl. REWARD: Legendary Sea Beast Armor — summon spectral tentacles with repeated firearm hits and leave slowing ink when you dodge.

Defeat Nacremaw, the Great Kraken, recover its expedition seal, then return to Diver Pearl. REWARD: Legendary Sea Beast Armor — summon spectral tentacles with repeated firearm hits and leave slowing ink when you dodge.
completion: The expedition seal is safe. REWARD: Legendary Sea Beast Armor — summon spectral tentacles with repeated firearm hits and leave slowing ink when you dodge.
discoveryClue: Follow the shell markers east of Crownrest Haven to Diver Pearl at the Drowned Maw seaside cave.
